topic.name: 全球经济与金融
topic.description: 追踪增长、贸易、通胀、利率、金融市场与供应链
topic.query: global economy finance trade inflation interest rates

overview: 今日专题“全球经济与金融”。共筛选 23 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

items.title: Why raising prices in Japan amid ‘insanely high’ inflation backfires on firms
items.summary: When Japan’s “symbol of affordability” Uniqlo decided to increase the price of its basic socks last month, it sparked a backlash before the clothing titan made an immediate U-turn. That came after Italian-style family restaurant chain Saizeriya issued an almost grovelling apology as it decided to add 20 yen (US$0.13) to the price of its trademark Milanese Doria, lamenting its “lack of effort”. The very public angst, including in one of the world’s most recognisable clothing brands, highlights...
items.titleZh: 为何日本在“极高”通胀下涨价反而让企业适得其反
items.summaryZh: 优衣库和萨莉亚等日本知名品牌近期因涨价引发公众强烈不满，甚至被迫道歉或撤回决定。这凸显了日本企业在应对高通胀时面临的巨大舆论压力。
items.whyImportant: 此现象反映了日本消费者对价格极其敏感的社会心理，限制了企业通过涨价转嫁成本的能力。

items.title: Drone attack on Colombian army base kills three soldiers and wounds 16
items.summary: Colombian President de la Espriella says those behind the attack in Santa Rosa del Sur will have ‘nowhere to hide’.
items.titleZh: 哥伦比亚陆军基地遭无人机袭击，造成三名士兵死亡、16人受伤
items.summaryZh: 哥伦比亚总统德拉埃斯皮利亚表示，袭击圣罗莎德尔苏尔基地的肇事者将“无处可藏”。目前政府正全力应对此次针对军事目标的袭击事件。
items.whyImportant: 此次袭击事件加剧了哥伦比亚国内的安全局势，并引发了政府对反恐和边境安全的关注。

items.title: Earthquake hits central Japan, injuring more than 20 people
items.summary: The magnitude 5.7 quake hit Shizuoka prefecture, and authorities warn of possible strong aftershocks in coming days.
items.titleZh: 日本中部发生地震，造成20多人受伤
items.summaryZh: 日本静冈县发生5.7级地震，造成20多人受伤。当局已发出警告，提醒民众未来几天需防范强余震。
items.whyImportant: 地震对当地基础设施和民众安全构成威胁，引发了对该地区地震活跃性的担忧。

items.title: Who is Eisenkot, the former Israeli general expected to replace Netanyahu?
items.summary: Gadi Eisenkot, an unassuming former army chief of staff, has a pathway to Israel’s top job after President Isaac Herzog tapped him to form the next government. Should he succeed, he would take over as prime minister from Benjamin Netanyahu, Israel’s longest-serving leader whose inflammatory style has earned him as much admiration as it has outright hatred. Eisenkot, by contrast, is a reserved man, and some voters tired of Netanyahu see his rival’s relative lack of charisma as one of his greatest...
items.titleZh: 有望取代内塔尼亚胡的前以色列将军艾森科特是谁？
items.summaryZh: 以色列总统赫尔佐格已授权前军队参谋长加迪·艾森科特组建新政府。艾森科特性格沉稳，被部分厌倦了内塔尼亚胡激进风格的选民视为替代人选。
items.whyImportant: 艾森科特的崛起可能标志着以色列政坛领导层的重大更迭，影响该国的未来政治走向。

items.title: Haitians cheer El Salvador’s Bukele amid gang war
items.summary: Some Haitians have cheered on El Salvadorian troops deployed to fight gangs in the Haitian capital.
items.titleZh: 海地民众在帮派战争中为萨尔瓦多的布克尔欢呼
items.summaryZh: 面对国内严重的帮派暴力，部分海地民众对萨尔瓦多部署军队打击帮派的做法表示支持。这种跨国支持反映了海地民众对恢复社会秩序的迫切渴望。
items.whyImportant: 此举显示了海地国内安全危机的严重性，以及民众对强力打击犯罪手段的期待。

items.title: Indonesians furious as Batam data centres drain taps: ‘we cannot cook without water’
items.summary: Cooking and bathing became difficult when taps ran dry in Batam, an Indonesian island where residents are protesting against data centres springing up to power the global artificial intelligence boom. The area had suffered a “long drought” caused by low rainfall, the local water utility operator said, as a strong El Nino cycle exacerbates dry weather. But, as in other countries, anger has been directed at the data centres, warehouse-like facilities that keep apps and AI tools running, with water...
items.titleZh: 印尼巴淡岛数据中心耗尽水源引发民众愤怒：“没水我们无法做饭”
items.summaryZh: 印尼巴淡岛因干旱和数据中心大量用水导致居民用水短缺，引发当地民众抗议。居民们对数据中心在资源匮乏时期消耗宝贵水资源感到不满。
items.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了全球人工智能基础设施扩张与当地资源可持续性之间的矛盾。

items.title: More than 140,000 rally as new protests against rising costs sweep France
items.summary: Tear gas fired in Paris and Lyon as interior minister warns authorities are 'ready and waiting' for rioters and looters.
items.titleZh: 法国爆发新一轮抗议生活成本上涨活动，超过14万人参加
items.summaryZh: 法国巴黎和里昂等地爆发抗议活动，警方动用催泪瓦斯驱散人群。内政部长警告称，当局已做好应对骚乱和抢劫的准备。
items.whyImportant: 持续的通胀压力引发的社会动荡，对法国政府的执政稳定构成了严峻挑战。

items.title: Israel’s president taps Eisenkot to form government, in setback for Netanyahu
items.summary: Israel’s president announced on Saturday he would task Gadi Eisenkot with forming the next government following last week’s election, in what Netanyahu’s rivals see as a first step to remove the country’s longest-serving prime minister. The opposition bloc led by Eisenkot, a former military chief and political newcomer who has tried to appeal to secular and liberal Israelis, has opened the door to a once improbable alliance with ultra-Orthodox Jews, which could give it the numbers to form a...
items.titleZh: 以色列总统授权艾森科特组建政府，内塔尼亚胡受挫
items.summaryZh: 以色列总统宣布由加迪·艾森科特负责组建新政府，这对内塔尼亚胡而言是一次重大挫折。艾森科特领导的反对派联盟正试图通过跨党派合作争取执政机会。
items.whyImportant: 这一政治变动可能终结内塔尼亚胡长期的执政地位，重塑以色列的权力格局。

items.title: Malaysian king warns against defying house arrest order for ex-PM Najib
items.summary: Malaysia’s king warned on Saturday that any attempt to ⁠challenge his order ⁠letting former prime minister Najib Razak go ⁠from jail to house arrest could amount to defying his decree, a day after authorities delayed Najib’s transfer. Najib has been in jail since 2022 after being found guilty of corruption and money laundering in a case linked to a multibillion-dollar ‌scandal at state fund 1Malaysia Development Berhad. He has consistently denied wrongdoing. He was due to be transferred home on...
items.titleZh: 马来西亚国王警告不得违抗前总理纳吉布的居家监禁令
items.summaryZh: 马来西亚国王警告称，任何挑战其允许前总理纳吉布从监狱转为居家监禁的命令的行为，都可能被视为违抗王室法令。此前当局推迟了纳吉布的转移计划，他因涉及一马发展公司数十亿美元的贪腐丑闻自2022年起入狱。
items.whyImportant: 此举凸显了马来西亚王室在国家政治事务中行使权力的敏感性及其对司法程序的影响。

items.title: Guatemalan lawmaker, 3 police officers killed in armed attack
items.summary: A Guatemalan ⁠lawmaker and three ⁠police officers were ⁠killed in an armed attack in the eastern department of Zacapa, President Bernardo Arevalo said, condemning the violence and ordering security forces to ‌help identify those responsible. Lawmaker Julio Cesar Portillo Paz was attacked on Friday in Rio Hondo, Zacapa, and initially taken to a hospital with serious injuries. His death was later confirmed by the ⁠National Unity of Hope party, or UNE, to which he ‌belonged. Arevalo said the three...
items.titleZh: 危地马拉一名议员及三名警察在武装袭击中丧生
items.summaryZh: 危地马拉总统贝尔纳多·阿雷瓦洛证实，该国东部萨卡帕省发生武装袭击，导致一名议员和三名警察死亡。总统强烈谴责暴力行为，并下令安全部队全力追查凶手。
items.whyImportant: 该事件反映了危地马拉国内严峻的安全挑战及针对公职人员的暴力威胁。

items.title: Hong Kong must build ‘reassuring’ environment amid political criticism: Paul Lam
items.summary: Hong Kong must focus on the “practical work” of building a safe and convenient environment and reassurring the international community amid criticism of its legal system, the justice minister has said, after 10 countries issued a joint statement decrying the latest jail sentence on opposition activist Joshua Wong Chi-fung. “It is inevitable that their criticism will continue… Political realities have to be dealt with, but I do not think we should allow them to distract us from our focus,”...
items.titleZh: 林定国：香港须在政治批评声中营造“令人安心”的环境
items.summaryZh: 香港律政司司长林定国表示，面对国际社会对香港法律制度的批评，香港应专注于营造安全便利的环境。他强调，尽管政治现实不可避免，但政府不应被外部批评分散注意力。
items.whyImportant: 此表态反映了香港政府在应对国际舆论压力时，试图通过强调法治与社会稳定来重塑国际信心的立场。

items.title: Uyghurs facing deportation by Thailand say they will be ‘like slaves’ in China
items.summary: Activists fear Bangkok will give in to pressure from Beijing despite reports of torture and human rights abuses against the mostly muslim ethnic minority The deportation of two more Uyghurs to China from Thailand would put their lives in grave danger, activists have said, with one of the men saying he would be “like a slave” if he was sent back. Last year, Thai authorities forcibly deported 40 Uyghur men to China despite pleas from the men themselves and the UN. The US and Canada had reportedly offered to resettle them, but Bangkok appeared to want to avoid upsetting Beijing. The UN has said the returnees’ whereabouts remain unknown. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 面临被泰国遣返的维吾尔人称回国后将“如同奴隶”
items.summaryZh: 人权活动人士担忧泰国政府在压力下将更多维吾尔人遣返回中国，面临遣返者表示回国后处境堪忧。尽管联合国及多国曾提出安置方案，但泰国此前仍有强制遣返记录。
items.whyImportant: 该问题涉及国际人权保护与地缘政治压力之间的复杂博弈。

items.title: Hong Kong must show real remorse for the Tai Po fire tragedy
items.summary: When Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu and seven principal officials bowed deeply before the cameras on October 29, Hong Kong witnessed something rare: a collective government apology. It came 11 months after the Wang Fuk Court fire claimed 168 lives and uprooted 1,984 households. A minister has resigned. Many reforms have been promised. Yet public reaction remains divided. That division reveals what people expect an apology to achieve, and how differently they understand political...
items.titleZh: 香港须对大埔火灾悲剧展现真正悔意
items.summaryZh: 香港行政长官李家超及多名官员此前就大埔火灾向公众鞠躬道歉，该事件造成重大伤亡并引发广泛社会影响。尽管政府承诺改革并有官员辞职，但公众对道歉的诚意及政治责任的理解仍存在分歧。
items.whyImportant: 这反映了香港社会对政府问责机制及危机处理方式的持续关注与审视。

items.title: Hong Kong firefighters get HK$8.4 million tracking upgrade after Tai Po fire
items.summary: Some 2,000 Hong Kong firefighters have been issued upgraded tracking devices after an independent inquiry into last year’s deadly Tai Po fire exposed technical limitations in the previous system, the South China Morning Post has learned. The Fire Services Department spent HK$8.4 million (US$1.1 million) on the new Firefighter Tracking Devices (FTDs), which cost more than HK$4,000 each, to help find personnel in distress more effectively. The November 1 roll-out came about a year after the Wang...
items.titleZh: 大埔火灾后，香港消防处斥资840万港元升级追踪系统
items.summaryZh: 针对去年大埔火灾中暴露的技术局限，香港消防处投入840万港元为约2000名消防员配备了新型追踪设备。该系统旨在提升救援人员在紧急情况下的定位效率。
items.whyImportant: 此举显示了香港消防部门在重大事故后通过技术升级来提升一线救援安全保障的努力。

items.title: Grief in China as rare snow leopard cub Ling Xiaohan loses 26-day fight for life
items.summary: Millions of Chinese internet users grieved after beloved snow leopard cub Ling Xiaohan died last Sunday, following 26 days of medical treatment after he was found weak, injured and unable to move in the Qinghai Lake reserve on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau. Despite intensive treatment efforts, the five-month-old cub died from complications arising from a severe brain injury, the cause of which is unknown, according to a statement by the Qinghai Wildlife Rescue and Breeding Centre. “The centre deeply...
items.titleZh: 中国罕见雪豹幼崽“凌小寒”经26天抢救无效死亡，引发网民哀悼
items.summaryZh: 在青海湖保护区被发现受伤的五个月大雪豹幼崽“凌小寒”，经26天全力救治后因脑部严重损伤并发症死亡。该消息在社交媒体上引发了数百万中国网民的广泛哀悼。
items.whyImportant: 该事件体现了公众对濒危野生动物保护及生态文明建设的高度关注。

items.title: NASA Seeks Next Generation of Explorers to Join Astronaut Corps
items.summary: NASA is looking for the explorers who will help write the next chapter of human spaceflight. Applications are now open for the agency’s next class of astronauts, who will join NASA as America returns to the Moon, builds the Moon Base, and lays the groundwork for the first crewed missions to Mars. The next generation […]
items.titleZh: NASA招募新一代宇航员加入宇航员队伍
items.summaryZh: 美国国家航空航天局（NASA）现已开放新一届宇航员申请通道。入选者将参与美国重返月球、建设月球基地以及未来载人火星任务的探索工作。
items.whyImportant: 这是美国推进深空探测计划的重要人才储备步骤，标志着人类航天探索进入新阶段。

items.title: Trump’s elevation of Stephen Miller a middle finger to millions of voters
items.summary: Architect of Trump’s far-right immigration agenda is now most powerful unelected figure in government – it suggests White House is moving to a war footing Donald Trump just gave the middle finger to millions of American voters. Any other president who suffered the kind of drubbing at the polls that Trump did this week might have felt at least a sliver of humility – and perhaps even an obligation to work with the new opposition in Congress. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 特朗普提拔斯蒂芬·米勒被视为对数百万选民的挑衅
items.summaryZh: 作为特朗普极右翼移民议程的设计师，斯蒂芬·米勒现已成为政府中最具权力的非民选官员。此举表明白宫正转向战时状态，引发了外界对其无视民意及对抗国会反对派的担忧。
items.whyImportant: 此任命标志着特朗普政府在移民政策上将采取更加强硬和激进的立场。

items.title: Trump’s war secretary Hegseth and Pacific Command chief Paparo may ‘soon visit China’
items.summary: Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth and US Pacific Command head Admiral Samuel Paparo may visit China “soon”, according to a veteran China hand. Stephen Orlins, president of the non-profit organisation National Committee on United States-China Relations (NCUSCR), disclosed the potential visit during a video address at a conference on Friday in Sanya, in southern China’s Hainan province. More than 400 Chinese officials, foreign diplomats and legal experts have gathered in the South China Sea resort city...
items.titleZh: 特朗普的国防部长赫格塞斯与美军太平洋司令部司令帕帕罗或将“很快访问中国”
items.summaryZh: 据美中关系全国委员会主席斯蒂芬·奥林斯透露，美国国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯和美军太平洋司令部司令塞缪尔·帕帕罗可能很快访问中国。这一消息是在海南三亚举行的一次会议上披露的。
items.whyImportant: 若访问成行，将是美中两国在军事外交领域的重要接触，有助于缓解双边紧张关系。

items.title: Stephen Miller, Trump’s incoming chief of staff, pledges ‘total devotion’ to the president
items.summary: Hardline aide offers ‘unwavering commitment’ to president amid fears White House will double down on far-right immigration agenda Stephen Miller, Donald Trump’s most controversial aide and the architect of his sweeping immigration crackdown, has lavished praise on the president after his appointment as White House chief of staff. In his first public remarks since the move was announced, Miller – who begins the role on Monday – pledged “total devotion” to Trump amid concern the administration is now poised to double down on its far-right, nativist immigration agenda. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 特朗普新任幕僚长斯蒂芬·米勒承诺对总统“绝对忠诚”
items.summaryZh: 作为特朗普最具争议的助手及移民打击计划的设计师，斯蒂芬·米勒在被任命为白宫幕僚长后，公开承诺对特朗普保持“绝对忠诚”。外界普遍担忧此举意味着白宫将进一步强化其极右翼本土主义移民议程。
items.whyImportant: 米勒的上位预示着白宫核心决策层将更加坚定地推行强硬的移民政策。

items.title: Four things we learned this week about 2028 White House race
items.summary: The seismic Democratic gains in Congress could shape the presidential election, so who had a good night and who's making moves?
items.titleZh: 关于2028年白宫竞选，本周我们了解到的四件事
items.summaryZh: 民主党在国会取得的重大进展可能会对总统选举产生深远影响。分析人士正在评估哪些政治人物在近期表现出色，以及谁正在为未来的竞选布局。
items.whyImportant: 国会选举结果的变化直接影响了未来总统大选的政治格局与候选人策略。

items.title: US offers $20m reward for information about Iran's nuclear programme
items.summary: Donald Trump has repeatedly raised the prospect of renewing strikes against Iran's nuclear facilities.
items.titleZh: 美国悬赏2000万美元征集有关伊朗核计划的情报
items.summaryZh: 美国政府宣布悬赏2000万美元，以获取有关伊朗核计划的情报。特朗普此前曾多次提及重新对伊朗核设施进行打击的可能性。
items.whyImportant: 此举加剧了美伊之间的紧张局势，并增加了中东地区核问题的地缘政治风险。

items.title: Japan rethinks its stalking laws after Pokemon store murder
items.summary: Long before Moe Harukawa was killed, she lived in fear. The 21-year-old shop assistant had reported her ex-boyfriend to police and a court had ordered him to stay away from her. Yet weeks later, Taiki Hirokawa, 26, walked into Harukawa’s workplace – a packed Pokemon store in Tokyo’s Ikebukuro district – and stabbed her repeatedly in the neck and torso before turning the knife he was carrying on himself. Both later died in hospital. Harukawa’s gruesome murder in March at the hands of a man who...
items.titleZh: 日本在宝可梦商店谋杀案后重新审视跟踪骚扰法
items.summaryZh: 21岁的店员原川萌在向警方报告并获得法院禁令后，仍被前男友在东京的宝可梦商店内杀害。这起惨剧促使日本政府重新评估现行跟踪骚扰法律的有效性与保护机制。
items.whyImportant: 该案件暴露了日本在处理跟踪骚扰案件及保护受害者方面的法律漏洞，引发了社会对公共安全政策的广泛讨论。

items.title: Victoria Barracks in Sydney and Melbourne to remain in public hands after partial backtrack on defence property selloff
items.summary: Four heritage-listed defence properties to be preserved for community use after backlash from veterans and former PMs Get our daily political email, free app or daily news podcast Richard Marles has denied claims Australia’s defence will be undermined by its decision to repurpose a historical military base near Sydney’s CBD for public use. The Albanese government announced on Sunday four heritage-listed defence sites, including Sydney’s Victoria Barracks, will remain in public hands after the plan generated considerable public backlash against their sale. Sign up for Guardian Australia’s Politics, really newsletter here Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 在国防资产出售计划部分撤回后，悉尼和墨尔本的维多利亚军营将保留在公共手中
items.summaryZh: 在遭到退伍军人和前总理的强烈反对后，澳大利亚政府宣布将保留包括悉尼维多利亚军营在内的四处具有历史意义的国防资产。国防部长理查德·马尔斯否认此举会削弱国防能力，强调这些场所将继续用于社区服务。
items.whyImportant: 政府对国防资产处置计划的调整反映了公众舆论对保护历史遗产和公共利益的重视。
